Write Data

write_data.Rd

Write Data

Usage

write_data(
  x,
  path = Sys.getenv("R_IKER_PATH"),
  resource = NULL,
  file,
  delim = ",",
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A data frame to write to disk.

path

A path where to write the data (see details).

resource

An optional resource name (used as sub folder inside path).

file

The name of the file to write (with extension)

delim

Single character used to separate fields within a record.

verbose

If TRUE, additional messages will be sent to the console

Value

returns the input x invisibly, or FALSE when it fails

Details

By default, path takes its value from the R_IKER_PATH environment variable. If it's not set in the environment and no value has been provided, function will be stopped (and return FALSE). If the corresponding path does not exist, it won't be created - to avoid creating data inside a container if the mount has not been done for example. When NULL, no check will be done.

Resource is an optional parameter to allow the use of sub folder inside path. If not NULL, it will be concatenated to path (and created inside path if it does not exist) When path is NULL, it will be ignored.

Columns with POSIXct type will be converted to ISO-8601 character columns before writing the file

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
write_data(foo, file = "my_data.csv")
} # }
